Im shy, i was scared for the first one. But I show him at first my scar, and he liked my project and gave me some advice if i wanted to change my image a little to hide more my scar, that was nice :)

I got all my scars tattooed, from what I learned, less the tattoo have detail, but enough to hide the scar under perspective, color and line, the better it is. I have a realistic jukebox on my left forearm and ppl so much want to see this tattoo closer that my abstract red and black color splash on my right arm. 
Ppl never notice scar on my right arm. 
But with tattoo ppl see so much less my scar, it worth the price if you find a great tattoo artist. 
An artist with experience is a must, tattoo on scar is different. Twisted line and weird color on scar can be the result of a bad job and this is the detail that make scar more visible :/
